resources.string: Before the assistant can answer your calls, please read how your calls are handled.
Call audio is sent outside India. It is processed by Amazon Bedrock in AWS Tokyo (ap-northeast-1).
Callers are answered by an automated assistant, not by a person. By default it says so at the start of the call.
Calls may be recorded. You can turn recording off in the agent settings.
Call logs, transcripts, and recordings are deleted after %1$d days by default. You can set this from 1 to 365 days.
Call data goes only to Exotel, Amazon Bedrock, and this app\'s own storage. It is not used to train a model.
